topics.title: Monorepo ownership and change routing
topics.summary: Route work by owned runtime surface and preserve atomic cross-component changes.
search: find apps services packages research infra -maxdepth 2 -type d | sort
invariants: One repository commit is the source identity for every affected component.
Do not recreate cross-repository synchronization for code already in this tree.

topics.title: Isolated worktrees and stacked pull requests
topics.summary: Use one lightweight monorepo worktree and a noninteractive gh stack.
invariants: Never mutate a dirty source checkout to obtain isolation.
Never merge unless the user separately authorizes it.

topics.title: Agent skill trees and context routing
topics.summary: Maintain the curated context index and keep every skill available to both agents and Claude.
invariants: Every skill must exist under both .agents/skills and .claude/skills.
Update the context index when ownership, canonical paths, or validation commands move.

topics.title: Dependabot and dependency-PR security review
topics.summary: Review dependency PRs against upstream source, then squash-merge or drive Dependabot with ignore/close comments.
invariants: Do not merge a dependency PR from its Dependabot summary; inspect upstream source and the owning-component check.
Never merge unless the user separately authorizes it.

topics.title: Validator, miner CLI, chain, and Compose runtime
topics.summary: The validator evaluates leased jobs and sets weights; the miner CLI packages, pays for, and uploads agents.
invariants: The validator is stateless; durable queue and score state belong to Platform.
Never expose signing material or provider credentials to untrusted jobs.

topics.title: Mine on SN118: practice, score, and submit a harness
topics.summary: Route miners and coding agents to the correct local scoring loop. cargo evaluate is name-only; ditto practice --run-size small/medium/full is live-bench rehearsal; walk the local served path against the Backroom operator review bar before full or upload; full is the on-chain envelope.
invariants: Do not treat cargo evaluate or hosted rehearsal as on-chain certification.
Local ditto practice --run-size full matches the on-chain dataset envelope and observed-tool scorer, not the locked model or screened image.
Do not package or upload a harness that fails the operator two-limb or production-engine bar.

topics.title: W&B validator and worker operations
topics.summary: Query bounded W&B run evidence through the authenticated API, then corroborate it with Platform or chain truth.
invariants: Never print or inspect the W&B API key or dump run configs.
W&B is diagnostic telemetry; Platform and chain state remain authoritative.

topics.title: Production Postgres, Platform API logs, Cloud Run job logs, and Targon rental logs
topics.summary: Read production Platform Postgres, live pm2 API logs, Cloud Run screening-job logs, and Targon rental logs through the read-only gcloud skill, then corroborate with builder identity.
invariants: Never print or inspect TARGON_API_KEY; stream it from Secret Manager into --api-key-stdin.
This workflow is read-only; do not create, probe, suspend, or delete rentals from it.

topics.title: Platform app VM disk inspect, cache reclaim, and boot size
topics.summary: A full 30G Platform boot disk blocks git fetch during platform-deploy. Inspect via IAP, reclaim caches with confirmation, then grow app_boot_disk_gb through protected Terraform.
search: rg -n 'app_boot_disk_gb|No space left on device' infra .github/workflows/platform-deploy.yml .agents/skills
invariants: Do not delete relay traces, Postgres, or .env to free space.
On google provider 6.x, grow the boot disk with gcloud then filesystem grow; Terraform size is ForceNew and must not replace the VM.
Cache reclaim requires the exact confirmation RECLAIM PLATFORM DISK CACHES.

topics.title: Private Python and Go runtime profiling
topics.summary: Capture private Python and Go sampling evidence through IAP SSH or authenticated Backroom relay controls, interpret exact running stacks, and compare equivalent before-and-after profiles.
invariants: Profiler listeners remain non-configurable loopback sockets reached only through checked-in IAP tooling or authenticated Backroom capture; never publish or proxy them.
Record exact deployed identity and representative workload; local source or an idle sample does not prove a live performance win.

topics.title: Platform API, database, migrations, and queue control
topics.summary: Platform owns HTTP contracts, durable state, scheduling, admission, leases, and administrative control.
validate: cd apps/platform && make lint lint-copy typecheck test
invariants: Alembic must have exactly one head and hot-table migrations must use the safe helpers.
Platform API changes mark Backroom affected; dashboard-only changes do not.

topics.title: Platform operator dashboard
topics.summary: The Platform dashboard visualizes public and operator-facing Platform data without owning API semantics.
invariants: Dashboard-only changes do not affect Backroom release selection.
Displayed rank and score semantics must come from authoritative Platform responses.

topics.title: Public subnet Backroom Worker
topics.summary: The public SN118 operator console runs as a Cloudflare Worker and calls Platform administrative APIs.
invariants: Keep OAuth, administrator lists, sessions, and Platform tokens out of browser code.
Generate the Platform contract locally; never dispatch to a sibling repository.

topics.title: Backroom quarantine triage and ATH board review
topics.summary: Review screening quarantines and scored high-rank agents through one Backroom skill, citing quarantine policy or ATH precedents before release, reject, clear, or hold.
validate: cd apps/platform && uv run pytest ditto/tests/api_server/endpoints/test_admin_copy_review.py -q -k precedents
cd apps/backroom && pnpm exec vitest run src/server/mcp.server.test.ts src/server/admin.service.test.ts
invariants: Cite a live or local precedent before resolving an ATH hold.
Ban is per agent UUID; same SHA or hotkey is a different row.
Do not open ATH on evaluating agents.

topics.title: Miner Discord and DM replies
topics.summary: Investigate miner questions against live Backroom state, then draft a paste-ready Discord reply. Mutations stay on backroom-review.
invariants: Investigate live Backroom state before drafting.
Do not promise a clear, un-ban, or extra emission slot in the miner-facing paste.

topics.title: Screener queue, autoscaling, Targon, GCE, and trusted builds
topics.summary: Platform queues work; the fenced controller reconciles Targon-first capacity with bounded GCE fallback and a separate trusted builder.
invariants: Targon is primary and GCE normally targets zero; fallback remains bounded and independently fenced.
Untrusted builds never receive cloud, GitHub, Platform, or provider credentials.

topics.title: Screening worker policy, gates, and source review
topics.summary: The screening worker leases submissions, builds the image, and applies policy gates. Capacity and Targon rentals live elsewhere.
invariants: Medium- and high-risk results are quarantined for operator review, never automatically rejected.
Untrusted builds never receive cloud, GitHub, Platform, or provider credentials.

topics.title: DittoBench execution, v8 scoring, and inference relay
topics.summary: DittoBench executes untrusted harnesses, enforces protocol contracts, and computes the versioned score consumed by validators.
invariants: Research adapters do not create alternate production scoring paths.
Any scoring change must preserve explicit version negotiation and frozen calibration inputs.

topics.title: Bench version bump across every layer
topics.summary: A bench_version is an immutable generation and scoring contract. Bump it on every layer in one stack; a leftover equality pin strands the new version.
search: rg -n 'BenchVersionV|SUPPORTED_BENCH_VERSIONS|CONFIRMATION_BENCH_VERSIONS|CurrentBenchVersion' ditto services apps packages research
invariants: Use floors and shared constants, never per-version enumerations.
Change every producer, consumer, generated artifact, and gate in one monorepo stack.

topics.title: Shadow coding-repair corpus, runtime, and agent harness
topics.summary: Compile and validate disjoint public coding practice packs, exercise the reference SWE agent, and verify digest-only assignment, selection, finalized issuance, validator ticket-set, task-lease, artifact-capability, artifact-delivery wire, verified-fetch, authoring-lease delivery, authoring-freeze ledger, grading-lease delivery, result-submission, attempt-coordinator, terminal-evidence, failure-classifier, attempt-runtime, evidence-outbox, memory-seed-projector, locked Luna relay contract, and ticket-bound Luna relay authority without changing production scoring or importing private corpus bytes.
invariants: Public practice identities, tasks, memories, and fixtures are disjoint from evaluation data.
The coding starter never owns the repository path, frozen patch, grader material, or score evidence.
The coding contract remains shadow-only and weight_eligible=false until a separately reviewed activation.

topics.title: Shadow durable Luna relay journal
topics.summary: Persist the ticket-bound Luna relay binding, pre-provider dispatch, terminal settlement, response replay, and revocation without wiring a live provider or score path.
invariants: Every provider dispatch is durable before upstream activity and an incomplete dispatch is never rerunnable.
Completion and revocation are exact-binding idempotent, private, bounded, and crash recoverable.
The journal remains unwired and weight_eligible=false until separately reviewed gateway and activation layers.

topics.title: Shadow screened-harness launch authority
topics.summary: Deliver one short-lived, ticket-bound screened-image capability to the private coding supervisor without starting a worker or exposing image credentials to the miner.
invariants: Only the current screened image bound to an active coding ticket and certification is delivered.
The image URL remains private, short-lived, redacted, and absent from miner/model/evidence bytes.
The authority remains shadow-only and weight_eligible=false until a separately reviewed worker activation.

topics.title: Shadow coding private runtime adapters
topics.summary: Load the exact screened image without executing it, bind workspace and Luna routes to the observed container source, and revoke the exact Platform grant without wiring a worker.
invariants: Screened-image loading cannot execute candidate code; Activate is separate and follows the durable non-rerunnable marker.
Workspace and inference routes require both an opaque token and the exact directly observed active container source; forwarding headers never grant authority.
The revocation client owns only the distinct revocation bearer and validates the exact terminal no-store acknowledgement before forgetting it.
No production worker constructs these adapters and coding v1 remains permanently weight_eligible=false.

topics.title: Shadow coding worker claim and publication handoff
topics.summary: Claim one shadow coding ticket without clean retry and hand exact signed Platform publication bytes through the durable validator outbox without wiring the worker.
validate: cd apps/platform && uv run python scripts/check_migration_order.py origin/main && uv run pytest -q ditto/tests/api_models/test_coding_claims.py ditto/tests/api_server/endpoints/test_validator_coding_claims.py ditto/tests/db/queries/test_coding_evaluations.py
uv run pytest -q ditto/tests/api_models/test_coding_claims.py ditto/tests/validator/test_coding_publication.py ditto/tests/validator/test_platform.py -k 'coding_claim or coding_publication'
invariants: An unstarted expired claim may transfer with a new generation; a started claim never grants a different instance a clean candidate retry.
The same stable instance may renew a started claim for restart recovery, and new publication requires that active started claim.
Exact signed request bytes are durable before Platform transmission and exact verified acknowledgement bytes are correlated by request digest afterward.
Pending recovery republishes durable bytes only and never reruns candidate code or recreates a capability.
No production worker constructs this handoff and coding v1 remains permanently weight_eligible=false.

topics.title: Default-off shadow coding worker composition
topics.summary: Compose the exclusive claim, phase-separated supervisor, durable publication outbox, and validator worker behind independent default-off gates without changing ordinary scoring or weights.
invariants: Every committed Platform, scorer, and validator coding worker gate is false.
Platform start commits before candidate execution and a started claim never grants a clean authoring retry.
Recovery republishes exact durable bytes; grading without a process-local session requires acknowledged authoring evidence independently observed in the outbox.
Authoring and grading executors are phase-separated so protected grader authority is unavailable during authoring.
The coding worker submits no ordinary score and coding v1 remains permanently weight_eligible=false.

topics.title: Shadow coding inference grant authority
topics.summary: Mint, exchange, and revoke the one locked Luna capability bound to a private shadow coding ticket without enabling provider execution.
validate: cd apps/platform && make lint lint-copy typecheck test
invariants: Coding grants bind CodingShadowTicket and the canonical locked Luna policy; ordinary inference grants are never reused.
Only bearer digests are stored and no provider credential is returned.
The transport remains explicitly disabled, shadow-only, and weight-ineligible until trusted settlement and gateway layers land.

topics.title: Shadow coding inference request ledger
topics.summary: Reserve ordered coding-model dispatches and durably persist canonical trusted provider settlements without enabling a live provider route.
validate: cd apps/platform && make lint lint-copy typecheck test
invariants: Every provider dispatch is durably reserved before upstream activity and only one request is active per grant.
Receipt-free retries preserve logical request identity; ambiguous provider activity is terminal and never rerunnable.
Only bounded canonical settlement projections are stored; prompts, raw responses, bearers, credentials, and private coding artifacts never enter the ledger.
Public-canary requests bind claimed-lease grants and never reuse the private-ticket request ledger.
The ledger remains shadow-only and weight_eligible=false until separately reviewed provider, gateway, scoring, and activation layers land.

topics.title: Shadow coding Platform upstream client
topics.summary: Send one proof-bound locked Luna dispatch from the validator relay to the future coding model-relay handler and verify its canonical trusted settlement.
invariants: Only the already-locked request enters the proof-bound dispatch; grant bearer, signing key, control fields, and miner headers never reach the model provider.
The client makes one no-redirect HTTP attempt and returns only a settlement whose complete binding and response digest it independently verifies.
Secrets are deep-owned, redacted, and zeroed; errors never include provider or private task text.
The client remains unwired and weight_eligible=false until the separately reviewed model-relay handler and gateway land.

topics.title: Shadow coding inference capability gateway
topics.summary: Compose one exchanged coding grant, Platform upstream client, durable relay journal, source-bound capability, exact revocation, and restart-safe evidence without wiring a worker or deployment.
invariants: A fresh activation durably binds its journal before publishing any miner-visible route.
Restart recovery never republishes a used capability or retries an ambiguous dispatch.
The outer route, local relay, and exact Platform grant are revoked before evidence is released.
The gateway remains unwired and weight_eligible=false until separate attempt, deployment, and activation reviews.

topics.title: Durable shadow coding publication journal
topics.summary: Persist exact signed authoring-freeze and terminal-result request bytes plus verified acknowledgements, and prevent shadow evidence release before terminal Platform acceptance.
invariants: Exact signed request and acknowledgement bytes are content addressed, bounded, and replayable after restart.
An authoring-freeze acknowledgement is a midpoint and never releases evidence retention.
A shadow attempt cannot release until its terminal acknowledgement and terminal evidence digest are durable and exact.
The journal remains transport-unwired and weight_eligible=false until separate supervisor, worker, and activation reviews.

topics.title: Private shadow coding attempt supervisor
topics.summary: Define the authenticated private Go supervisor wire, process-local prepared-session state machine, and Python CodingAttemptRuntime client without mounting a phase runner or registering the worker.
validate: cd services/dittobench-api && go test -race ./internal/codingsupervisor && go vet ./internal/codingsupervisor
invariants: The private handler requires the existing scorer control token and stores only its digest.
The session backend retains the broker private key; Python sees only the public key and always revokes the exchanged grant generation.
Production key and session generation always use cryptographic entropy; test entropy hooks are package-private and duplicate identities fail closed.
The runner-visible and retained private-key buffers are zeroed after the one authoring call, including terminal failure and cancellation.
A started authoring or grading phase is never rerun; successful response-loss retries return deep-owned cached evidence.
One ticket/run is single-flight and all operation/result identities are exact and bounded.
No composition root mounts the handler, injects the available phase runner, or constructs the Python runtime client.
The supervisor remains shadow-only and weight_eligible=false until separate worker and activation reviews.

topics.title: Private coding execution-plan contract
topics.summary: Commit task-static runner authority in private catalog leaves and deliver runner versus protected grader plans through separate phase-gated leases.
validate: uv run ruff check ditto/api_models/coding.py ditto/tests/api_models/test_coding.py
cd apps/platform && uv run python ../../packages/dittobench-coding-contract/generate_execution_delivery_vectors.py --check && make lint lint-copy typecheck test
invariants: Authoring runner plans contain no grader bundle, protected commands, hidden test counts, provider authority, or credentials.
Protected grader plan and resource projections are validator-only and delivered only after an accepted freeze.
Runner/runtime-policy/grader/resource identities and canonical digests fail closed on private-record and response drift.
Only the unwired shadow phase runner consumes this delivery; no worker, score, or weight path does.
Coding contract v1 remains permanently weight_eligible=false.

topics.title: Shadow coding model-relay handler
topics.summary: Verify proof-bound coding dispatches, reserve the coding ledger before provider activity, and persist canonical Luna settlements behind an independent disabled gate.
validate: cd services/model-relay && make fmt-check vet test sqlc-check release-build
invariants: The coding gate defaults disabled and ordinary inference enablement cannot activate it.
The locked request is durably reserved before one provider attempt; missing settlement becomes terminal unsettled and revokes the grant.
Inbound grant/proof headers and control fields never reach OpenRouter; provider credentials never reach the validator or miner.
The handler remains deployment-unwired and weight_eligible=false until a separately reviewed gateway and rollout land.

topics.title: Datagen research and third-party benchmark adapters
topics.summary: Research data, calibration evidence, and third-party adapters live beside DittoBench but outside production score semantics unless deliberately promoted.
invariants: Keep raw evidence and reproducible manifests with research conclusions.
Do not change v8 scoring merely to improve an adapter result.

topics.title: LongMemEval confirmation rollout
topics.summary: Drive LongMemEval confirmation from a production failure through fail-closed repair, exact release, fleet adoption, and one accepted signed canary.
invariants: A green PR is not live accepted confirmation.
Do not infer one evidence rung from another.

topics.title: Cross-component protocols and generated contracts
topics.summary: Shared wire and screening contracts must change atomically with every producer, consumer, generated artifact, and compatibility test.
validate: cd apps/backroom && pnpm check && pnpm test
invariants: Change producers and consumers in one stack, not through bot PRs.
Generated artifacts must identify the same monorepo revision as their source.

topics.title: Affected components, semantic release, builds, and deployments
topics.summary: The affected-component graph selects versioned artifacts and automatic application deploys from one exact release commit.
invariants: A fix releases every affected component; infra changes remain protected plan/apply.
API changes affect Backroom, dashboard-only changes do not.

topics.title: GCP, Cloudflare, Terraform, Ansible, and secrets
topics.summary: Terraform owns reviewed cloud state; GitHub OIDC identities deploy applications; Ansible converges hosts; secrets stay in provider stores.
invariants: Never read, print, or persist provider secret values while testing integrations.
Automatic app deploys and protected infrastructure apply are separate authority boundaries.

topics.title: Preview planning, Foundry overlay, and local DittoBench simulator
topics.summary: Preview plan validation and a loopback-only overlay/fault harness, plus the localstack/phase-1 simulator that actually scores a harness. Preview up does not deploy the planned stack.
validate: uv run python -m ditto.preview compose dashboard
invariants: Only dashboard plans may attach to production Platform; Backroom requires isolation.
preview-control accepts only loopback endpoints and binds.
The workflow validates controls but does not deploy resources or publish releases.
Sessionless SCORED=1 v9+ cannot complete without a broker session; use SCORED=0 or phase-1 for v12.
